steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: After Salamis, Xerxes returned to Persia leaving Mardonius with an army to complete the conquest of Greece | Key Fact: Mardonius tried to divide the Greeks by offering Athens favourable terms; Athens refused and the city was evacuated again | Key Fact: At Plataea (479 BC), the Greek army under the Spartan regent Pausanias defeated the Persians; Mardonius was killed | Key Fact: The Battle of Mycale (479 BC) was a simultaneous Greek naval victory that destroyed the remaining Persian fleet in Ionia

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from plataea &amp; the aftermath (479 bc), and one past-paper question.
